evidence: A valid signed raw-audit admission is accepted in development.
The same admission is hard-disabled for all four protected aliases: production, prod, staging, and stage.
Disabled, missing, or invalid admission paths do not persist raw model calls or open raw-audit transactions while the backtest remains successful.
Missing signed Gate B admission resolves to NoOp; a forged test-only sink marker is never opened.
All four protected aliases force admission and persistent-sink resolution to NoOp without invoking an external provider.
Unavailable initial revocation verification, write-time expiry, and write-time revocation deny raw writes before additional SQL, roll back, and close the fake session.
Revocation during analysis preserves the successful analysis result while stopping subsequent audit SQL.
Fixed replay rejects a wrong disposable database and a wrong application_name marker.
The unit verifier writes a signed BLOCKED artifact before SQL when signer, SBOM, and trusted-root inputs are absent.
The fixed migration sequence, pgcrypto/PG17 catalog contract, replay workflow database isolation, artifact upload, and forced-discard runner contract are statically pinned.
Purge uses strict created_at < cutoff semantics, retains the exact cutoff and future rows, batches with SKIP LOCKED, and returns zero on rerun.
The purge targets only app.ai_prompt_log and preserves parent rows.
skips: Two real PostgreSQL retention integration tests skipped because AI_PROMPT_RETENTION_TEST_DSN was not set to a disposable database.
AI_LOGGING_TEST_DSN must point to a disposable TimescaleDB database.

results.summary: Verifier wrote a BLOCKED artifact before SQL.
evidence: markers transition from CREATED version 0 to BLOCKED version 1

contractCoverage.contract: Raw logging accepts a verified development admission, but hard-disables production, prod, staging, and stage aliases and fails closed for disabled or forged-marker paths.
AI raw-audit admission is revalidated before subsequent writes; expiry and revocation stop raw SQL without changing the business analysis outcome.

Fixed replay rejects invalid disposable DSN components and blocks before SQL without external signer inputs; fixed migrations require the pgcrypto/PG17 and workflow isolation/discard static contracts.
Prompt purge is strictly before the cutoff, preserves boundary and future rows, is safe to rerun, and uses SKIP LOCKED batches.

adversarialCases.case: four protected raw-audit aliases and valid development admission
adversarialCases.evidence: Development accepted the valid signed admission. production, prod, staging, and stage each rejected the same admission and forced AI persistent-sink resolution to NoOp.

adversarialCases.case: disabled, missing, invalid, or forgeable raw-audit admission
adversarialCases.evidence: Disabled/missing/invalid backend admissions opened no raw-audit transaction; unsigned Gate B and the forgeable test-only sink marker resolved to NoOp without opening the forged sink.

adversarialCases.case: AI session expiry or revocation between writes
adversarialCases.evidence: Both conditions stopped the next write before additional SQL, rolled back, and closed the fake session; revocation during analysis retained successful business output.

adversarialCases.case: invalid replay disposable DSN and marker
adversarialCases.evidence: Wrong database and application_name marker variants raised the fixed replay contract error.
The real verifier exited 2 before SQL and wrote /tmp/p0-fixed-replay-blocked.json with external_signer, sbom, and trusted_root missing.

adversarialCases.case: pgcrypto, workflow static contract, and fixed replay order
adversarialCases.evidence: Static tests pin pgcrypto provision before replay, PG17/catalog assertions, separate replay/purge databases, artifact upload, and forced-discard markers; live replay remains blocked by absent external inputs.

adversarialCases.case: purge cutoff boundary, future rows, rerun, and disposable DB absence
adversarialCases.evidence: Unit tests preserved boundary/future rows and verified rerun zero; real retention and TimescaleDB tests skipped because no disposable PostgreSQL DSN was supplied.

blockers.reason: SERVICE_DB_REPLAY_EXTERNAL_SIGNER, SERVICE_DB_REPLAY_SBOM, and SERVICE_DB_REPLAY_TRUSTED_ROOT were intentionally absent; the verifier stopped before SQL.
AI_LOGGING_TEST_DSN was not set to a disposable TimescaleDB database.
AI_PROMPT_RETENTION_TEST_DSN was not set to a disposable database.

blockers.surface: External provider and raw-on/canary/Gate B activation
blockers.reason: No external signer/provider or raw-on/canary/Gate B activation was invoked. All admission and audit cases used local fakes or fail-closed paths.
